Support Vector Machine: Board Game

Max Glonek

Trimester 1, 2025

1 Load data

tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load("2019-03-12")
board <- tuesdata$board_games
write_rds(board, glue::glue("{wdpath}/data/board.rds"))
board <- read_rds(glue::glue("{wdpath}/data/board.rds"))

2 Clean up

board <- 
  board %>% 
  select(
    rating = average_rating, 
    time = playing_time, 
    year = year_published
  )
board
board %>% ggplot(aes(time)) + geom_histogram(col = "black", fill = "orange")
## `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value with `binwidth`.

board <- 
  board %>% 
  filter(time > 0, time <= 360)
board %>% ggplot(aes(time)) + geom_histogram(col = "black", fill = "orange")
## `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value with `binwidth`.

Convert rating into three levels

board <- 
  board %>% 
  mutate(
    rating = cut_number(
      rating, 3, 
      labels = c("pants", "yeah", "wow")
    )
  )

3 EDA

board %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, time, 
             col = rating)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) + 
  scale_colour_hp(house = "ravenclaw", discrete = TRUE)

board %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, time, 
             col = rating)) + 
  geom_density_2d() + 
  scale_colour_hp(house = "ravenclaw", discrete = TRUE)

4 Model

board_wf <- 
  workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(
    recipe(rating ~ ., data = board) %>% 
      step_log(time)
  ) %>% 
  add_model(
    svm_poly(mode = "classification", degree = 2) %>% 
      set_engine("kernlab")
  )
board_M1 <- board_wf %>% fit(board)
board_M1
## ══ Workflow [trained] ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
## Preprocessor: Recipe
## Model: svm_poly()
## 
## ── Preprocessor ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 1 Recipe Step
## 
## • step_log()
## 
## ── Model ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Support Vector Machine object of class "ksvm" 
## 
## SV type: C-svc  (classification) 
##  parameter : cost C = 1 
## 
## Polynomial kernel function. 
##  Hyperparameters : degree =  2  scale =  1  offset =  1 
## 
## Number of Support Vectors : 8611 
## 
## Objective Function Value : -5606.772 -3687.363 -4878.051 
## Training error : 0.470489 
## Probability model included.
board_M2 <- 
  board_wf %>% 
  update_model(
    svm_rbf(mode = "classification") %>% 
      set_engine("kernlab")
  ) %>% 
  fit(board)
board_M3 <- 
  board_wf %>% 
  update_model(
    rand_forest(mode = "classification") %>% 
      set_engine("ranger")
  ) %>% 
  fit(board)

5 Predict

newdata <- crossing(
  year = seq(1980, 2016, length = 100),
  time = seq(1, 360, length = 100)
)
newdata %>% 
  add_column(
    predict(board_M1, new_data = newdata)
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, time, fill = .pred_class)) + 
  geom_hex() + 
  scale_fill_hp(house = "ravenclaw", discrete = TRUE)

newdata %>% 
  add_column(
    predict(board_M2, new_data = newdata)
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, time, fill = .pred_class)) + 
  geom_hex() + 
  scale_fill_hp(house = "ravenclaw", discrete = TRUE)

newdata %>% 
  add_column(
    predict(board_M3, new_data = newdata)
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, time, fill = .pred_class)) + 
  geom_hex() + 
  scale_fill_hp(house = "ravenclaw", discrete = TRUE)

board %>% 
  add_column(
    predict(board_M1, new_data = board, type = "prob")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(type = "SVM poly") %>% 
  bind_rows(
    board %>% 
      add_column(
        predict(board_M2, new_data = board, type = "prob")
      ) %>% 
      mutate(type = "SVM radial")
  ) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    board %>% 
      add_column(
        predict(board_M3, new_data = board, type = "prob")
      ) %>% 
      mutate(type = "RF")
  ) %>% 
  group_by(type) %>% 
  roc_curve(rating, starts_with(".pred")) %>% 
  autoplot()
